Prior finding l1-run4-001 VERIFIED RESOLVED: the amended §5.1 rule 2 ('.slice(0, 255), then drop a trailing lone high surrogate (code unit 0xD800-0xDBFF)... 254 code units in that case') describes the shipped sanitizeTrackingValue exactly — slice(0, TRACKING_VALUE_MAX_LENGTH=255), charCodeAt check for 0xd800-0xdbff, slice(0, -1) — and the companion amendment sites §7 constraint 1 ('254 when the slice would split a surrogate pair — 5.1 rule 2') and §11 note 4 ('255-code-unit surrogate-safe cap (5.1 rule 2)') are consistent with it. Sanctioning commit fa51c91a5 ('Make tracking param truncation surrogate-safe in sanitizeTrackingParams') exists and is an ancestor of HEAD. One boundary nuance recorded, not a finding: the code drops a trailing high surrogate unconditionally, while the amended text scopes the drop to 'left when the slice splits a surrogate pair' — the two coincide for every reachable input because location.search is a USVString (lone surrogates cannot arrive from the URL; percent-encoded CESU-8 surrogates decode to U+FFFD via decode-uri-component), and the spec's own invariant sentence ('A value must never end in an unpaired surrogate') covers the unconditional check. Two immaterial line-number drifts in spec citations (not findings, both patterns verified live): NewJobCenterModal trackEvent('job_created') is at line 47 (spec §8 says 46); OnboardingProfile wasInvited/isNewOwner now at lines 17-18 (spec §5.6 says 16-17 — shifted by the diff's own trackEvent import). Reverse-trace also complete for the sweep: every hunk in all 22 diff files traces to a spec section; no unspecced code, methods, validations, or files found.
